name: What types of windows can be used for a single replacement?

mainEntity.name: What types of windows can be used for a single replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: A wide variety of window types can be used for single replacement, matching or upgrading your home's existing style. Common options include double-hung, casement, sliding, picture, and bay or bow windows. The choice depends on your aesthetic preferences, functional needs, and the architectural style of your home. We work with various materials such as vinyl, wood, and fiberglass, each offering different benefits in terms of durability, maintenance, and energy efficiency. We can help you select the best fit.
acceptedAnswer.description: You can choose from various types like double-hung, casement, or sliding windows, available in materials like vinyl, wood, or fiberglass.
